source_instruction: i would like a black face kit with green tea.
query:
You won’t believe what happened on my walk over to the store today! I cut through the little neighborhood park like I usually do, and there was a tiny calico kitten perched right on the arm of the old wooden bench by the fountain, batting at a dandelion puff that kept blowing just out of its reach. I stopped for a minute to say hi, and it trotted right over, climbed onto my shoe, and purred so loud I could feel it through my sneaker before its owner—an older lady carrying a basket of fresh peonies from the community garden—called it over to keep walking. I ended up chatting with her for almost ten minutes about how she’d adopted the kitten from the local shelter last month, and she even gave me a peony stem that had snapped off her bunch to tuck into my bag; it’s sitting on the shelf by the store entrance right now, smelling so sweet it’s making the whole entryway feel like summer.
Hey, I’m browsing the eye care section right now looking for something with oolong tea in it, can you help me find options? I’d really like ones that come with a free reusable microfiber cleaning cloth for glasses too, that’d be super handy. I don’t want to spend more than 30 bucks total, and I have a preference for a specific color variant but I don’t remember what it was I was supposed to pick? Wait, no, actually I just need to stay under that price point for sure, and I don’t want any weird added fragrances that might irritate my eyes.
